clusters.mechanism: Digest ignores review.round_started, so a PR stays 'awaiting review' while a review round is running.
Digest 'Blocked lands' group is cleared only by land.queued/land.landed, not by pr.merged/pr.closed/run.merged/run.resolved, so externally merged or closed PRs stay listed as blocked.
mcp-status schema drops the persisted run.merged flag, so a confirmed merge without a PR snapshot or landed entry is reported as unknown.
Digest permanently removes a PR on review.approved and never restores it when a head change makes the approval stale.
A failed or cancelled historical review round takes precedence over a later valid approval in status.
Answered questions are never cleared from the digest's 'Needs you' because answering emits no clearing event.
GET /api/land with an empty run= value is converted to an empty string, so land.list throws 'run not found' instead of listing.
MCP limitless_review omits the reviewer, so approvals are recorded as 'human' instead of being attributed to MCP/agent.
Status checks the blocked-land branch before the CLOSED PR observation, so a closed PR is reported as landing blocked.
'PRs awaiting review' is not cleared by run.resolved or run.cancelled, so resolved or cancelled runs' PRs stay listed.
The Codex skill is a copy of the Claude skill and recommends the 'claude' consumer cursor name.
Change size exceeds the stated ~200-line budget.
